channel.title: Business Directories — Petro Hrys
channel.description: Manually verified business directory research from PetroHrys.com.

item.title: SOS Business Entity Search
item.description: SOS Business Entity Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Indiana Secretary of State, Business Services Division. Search fields: Per the IN.gov mobile services page: a "Full Name" or "Partial Name" search of a business entity. Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: Business Search
item.description: Business Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Mississippi Secretary of State — Business Services & External Affairs (Business Services Division). Coverage: The corporations database covers registered business entities generally. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Arizona Business Center
item.description: Arizona Business Center is the state business-entity register operated by the Arizona Corporation Commission. Search-form labels present in the live application include "Business Name", "Business ID", "Entity Name", "Principal Name", "Statutory Agent Name" and "Trade Name". Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Entity Search
item.description: Business Entity Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Michigan Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs (LARA), Corporations, Securities & Commercial Licensing Bureau, Corporations Division. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Services Online Filings Portal
item.description: Business Services Online Filings Portal is the state business-entity register operated by the New Mexico Secretary of State, Business Services Division. Coverage: The Secretary of State homepage states the portal can be used to "search for a registered business, fictitious name or trademark". Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Search
item.description: Business Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Corporations Division of the Georgia Secretary of State's Office (Office of the Georgia Secretary of State, Brad Raffensperger). It covers corporations Division registrations, covering domestic and foreign entities. Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: Business Search
item.description: Business Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Missouri Secretary of State — Corporations Division. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Entities Search
item.description: Business Entities Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Oklahoma Secretary of State — Business Records Department. Coverage: Per the Business Records Department page: "corporations, limited partnerships, limited liability companies, limited liability partnerships, partnership fictitious names, trade names and trademarks." Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Business Name Search
item.description: Business Name Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Pennsylvania Department of State, Bureau of Corporations and Charitable Organizations. Search fields: Business name and entity/file number. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Search
item.description: Business Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Vermont Secretary of State, Business Services Division. It covers business entities registered with the Business Services Division. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Entities Online
item.description: Business Entities Online is the state business-entity register operated by the South Carolina Secretary of State's Office, Business Filings Division. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Government Records Inquiry System
item.description: Government Records Inquiry System is the state business-entity register operated by the Alabama Secretary of State — Business Services, Business Entities Division. Coverage: The Secretary of State states: "The Business Entity Division operates as a depository for records of domestic entities and foreign entities that have qualified to transact business in Alabama." Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Canadian Patents Database
item.description: Canadian Patents Database is the federal patent register published by the Canadian Intellectual Property Office. It exposes Canadian patent applications and granted patents, with bibliographic data, claims and legal status, searchable without an account.

item.title: MRAS Canadian Business Registry
item.description: MRAS Canadian Business Registry is a federal search interface that queries participating provincial, territorial and federal corporate registers through the Multi-Jurisdictional Registry Access Service. It is a cross-registry lookup layer operated by Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada, not itself a register of record.

item.title: SEDAR+
item.description: SEDAR+ is the national filing and disclosure system of the Canadian Securities Administrators, carrying public securities filings by reporting issuers together with cease trade orders and disciplined lists. It is operated jointly by the provincial and territorial securities regulators rather than by a federal agency.

item.title: Ontario Business Registry
item.description: Ontario Business Registry is the provincial register of Ontario corporations, not-for-profit corporations and registered business names, operated by the Ministry of Public and Business Service Delivery and Procurement. Basic entity information is searchable at no charge, while profile reports, certificates and document copies are priced products.

item.title: Enterprise register
item.description: The Quebec enterprise register is the provincial register of enterprises maintained by the Registraire des entreprises, recording enterprises that carry on business in Quebec together with the persons involved in their administration and operation. Québec publishes the register as public information and offers both a simple and an advanced search.

item.title: Licence holders register
item.description: The licence holders register of the Régie du bâtiment du Québec records contractors and owner-builders licensed to carry out construction work in Quebec. The Régie directs the public to the register to check a contractor or a licence number before engaging them.

item.title: BC Registry Services
item.description: BC Registry Services administers the British Columbia registers of businesses, not-for-profit societies, cooperative associations and financial institutions, and states that the records it maintains are public records. Searches and certificates are supplied through its search unit and the BC OnLine service.

item.title: Companies Office
item.description: The Manitoba Companies Office maintains the provincial registers of corporations, business names, trade names and limited partnerships within the Consumer Protection Division. Manitoba states that the public may search the registry to establish who is behind a trade name and to obtain a list of officers and directors.

item.title: Registry of Joint Stock Companies
item.description: The Registry of Joint Stock Companies is the Nova Scotia register of sole proprietorships, partnerships, companies, societies, co-operatives and business names. Nova Scotia publishes a search over the information those entities are required by law to file, including addresses, partners, directors and officers.

item.title: Companies and Deeds Online
item.description: Companies and Deeds Online is the Newfoundland and Labrador registry service covering companies, co-operatives, condominiums, deeds, mechanics liens and lobbyists. It is published by the provincial government as a single online entry point to those separate registers.

item.title: Corporate Registry
item.description: The Saskatchewan Corporate Registry is the provincial register of business entities, delivered under agreement by Information Services Corporation rather than directly by a government office. The registry remains statutory while the service that fronts it is operated commercially and presents a sign-in wall.

item.title: Corporate Registries
item.description: Corporate Registries is the Northwest Territories register of territorial incorporations, extra-territorial registrations, societies, co-operative associations, partnerships and business names, administered by the territorial Department of Justice. Basic entity information is available at no charge through the Corporate Registries Online System.

item.title: Legal Registries Division
item.description: The Legal Registries Division of the Nunavut Department of Justice administers the territory’s corporate registries together with its personal property registry, land titles office and securities office. Nunavut states that almost all records are available to the public to view or obtain copies.

item.title: APRA Registers
item.description: APRA Registers is the national register operated by the Australian Prudential Regulation Authority. The registers are published as browsable lists rather than a search application.

item.title: Australian Trade Mark Search
item.description: Australian Trade Mark Search is the national register operated by IP Australia. It records registered and pending Australian trade marks. The operator lists searchable dimensions as Word, Phrase, Image, Owner, and Goods and services.

item.title: Victorian Incorporated Associations Public Register
item.description: Victorian Incorporated Associations Public Register is the state register operated by Consumer Affairs Victoria. It records incorporated associations registered in Victoria under the Associations Incorporation Reform Act 2012. Search by incorporated association name, by registration number, or by browsing associations pending cancellation.

item.title: AssociationsOnline
item.description: AssociationsOnline is the state register operated by the Department of Local Government, Industry Regulation and Safety (LGIRS) — Consumer Protection. It records associations incorporated in Western Australia under the Associations Incorporation Act 2015. Search fields: Free-text search by association name or by IARN (Incorporated Association Registration Number). The results grid returns four columns, confirmed from the live table headers: Association Name, Number, Status, Date Incorporated.

item.title: Licensing NT Public Register
item.description: Licensing NT Public Register is the territory register operated by the Northern Territory Government. It records holders of business and professional licences and registrations issued under nine Northern Territory licensing schemes. Licence Number; Licence Scheme (optional dropdown of the nine schemes — leaving it blank searches across all); Business Name with Exact Name / Partial Name / Sounds Like matching; Licensee Name with the same three matching modes; a checkbox "Only Display Active Licences and Registrations" (ticked by default); and Suburb or Postcode.

item.title: QBCC Licensee Register
item.description: QBCC Licensee Register is the state register operated by the Queensland Building and Construction Commission. It records holders of QBCC building and construction licences in Queensland — both individuals and companies, across contractor, builder, trade contractor, nominee supervisor and site supervisor licence classes. A licensee is looked up by name or by licence number — QBCC states "if you have a person's licence number or name, you can look them up in our [licensee register]".

item.title: WA Online Licence Search
item.description: WA Online Licence Search is the state register operated by the Department of Local Government, Industry Regulation and Safety. It records holders of occupational licences, registrations, permits, certificates and accreditations issued under Western Australian law by three divisions of the department. Search fields: A licence type must be selected first; the form then exposes, per type, company/business or family name, first name, location or post code, a search-all-WA option, date of birth (for individual credentials such as High Risk Work Licence and Construction Induction Training Card), and charity category for the Charity type. The application also carries a licence-number lookup path. Records returned include the licensee or entity name, licence number, licence type and sub-type (individual, body corporate/company, partnership), licence status, expiry date, entity type, trading names where held, and a business locality.

item.title: Check a charity or association
item.description: Check a charity or association is the state register operated by the Office of Fair Trading, Department of Justice (Queensland). It records associations incorporated in Queensland under the Associations Incorporation Act 1981 (Qld), and charities authorised to fundraise in Queensland under the Collections Act 1966 (Qld). Search fields: Organisation Number (e.g. IA or CH prefixed numbers, partial matches accepted), Organisation Name, and Organisation Postcode — singly or in combination.

item.title: Incorporated Associations Search
item.description: Incorporated Associations Search is the state register operated by Consumer and Business Services. It records incorporated associations registered in South Australia under the Associations Incorporation Act 1985 (SA), administered by Consumer and Business Services. Two search modes are offered, presented as tabs labelled "By Name / Reg No" and "By Public Officer".

item.title: ACT Incorporated Associations Public Register
item.description: ACT Incorporated Associations Public Register is the territory register operated by Access Canberra, City and Environment Directorate, ACT Government. It records associations incorporated in the ACT under the Associations Incorporation Act 1991. Five fields are displayed for every record: Association number (format A#####, e.g. A00266), Association name, Status, Date of incorporation and Date of cessation.

item.title: Tasmanian Licensed Occupations Search
item.description: Tasmanian Licensed Occupations Search is the state register operated by Consumer, Building and Occupational Services (CBOS), Department of Justice, Tasmania. It records current holders of Tasmanian occupational licences administered by CBOS, in five licence areas as listed by the search application: "Electrical, Plumbing, Gas Fitting and Automotive Gas Fitting", "Building Services Provider", "Motor Vehicle Trader", "Security and Investigation", and "Conveyancer". The public first chooses a licence area; for Building Services Provider a further licence-type step appears with the options "Company", "Municipal Council" and "Individual".

item.title: OpenCorporates
item.description: Open legal-entity database aggregating company records sourced from more than 140 official government registries.

item.title: Trustpilot
item.description: Open consumer review platform where any customer can publish a rating of a business, with a free tier for collecting reviews.

item.title: Yelp for Business
item.description: Local business listing and consumer review platform; claiming a basic business page is free, with paid advertising available.

item.title: Capterra
item.description: Software comparison directory listing business applications by category with verified user reviews and feature breakdowns.

item.title: Software Advice
item.description: Software advisory and comparison directory pairing category listings with verified user reviews and a free recommendation service.

item.title: AlternativeTo
item.description: Crowd-sourced catalogue of software alternatives, ranking roughly 150,000 applications by user opinion.

item.title: Clutch
item.description: B2B service-provider directory covering development, design and marketing firms, built around verified client interviews.

item.title: DesignRush
item.description: Agency directory and awards platform listing design, development and marketing firms with star-rated client feedback.

item.title: Crunchbase
item.description: Private-market intelligence platform profiling companies, investors and people, with a public company-profile submission route.

item.title: Product Hunt
item.description: Daily launch platform where new software products are posted and ranked by community upvotes and comments.

item.title: Wellfound
item.description: Startup talent marketplace hosting company profiles for more than 27,000 startups, with free unlimited job posting.

item.title: Shopify App Store
item.description: Official marketplace of applications extending Shopify stores, with merchant star ratings and review counts on every listing.

item.title: Salesforce AppExchange (AgentExchange)
item.description: Salesforce enterprise application marketplace; the storefront now presents itself under the AgentExchange name.

item.title: HubSpot App Marketplace
item.description: Official HubSpot marketplace listing integrations, workflows and templates that connect to the HubSpot platform.

item.title: GitHub Marketplace
item.description: GitHub marketplace cataloguing Apps and Actions across continuous integration, code quality, deployment and security.

item.title: WordPress Plugin Directory
item.description: Official directory of free and open-source WordPress plugins, with user ratings and install counts on every entry.

item.title: Add-ons for Firefox
item.description: Mozilla-operated catalogue distributing Firefox extensions, themes, dictionaries and language packs with user star ratings.

item.title: Python Package Index (PyPI)
item.description: Official package repository for the Python language, maintained by the Python Software Foundation.

item.title: RubyGems.org
item.description: Package host for the Ruby language, operated by Ruby Central and the RubyGems team.

item.title: Packagist.org
item.description: Main Composer repository, aggregating public PHP packages for dependency installation.

item.title: crates.io
item.description: Official package registry for the Rust language, operated by the Rust Foundation.

item.title: NuGet Gallery
item.description: Central package repository for the .NET ecosystem, operated by Microsoft.

item.title: Maven Central
item.description: Central repository of open-source components for the Java and JVM ecosystem, operated by Sonatype.

item.title: pub.dev
item.description: Official package repository for Dart and Flutter applications, supported by Google.

item.title: Hex
item.description: Package manager for the Erlang ecosystem, serving Elixir, Erlang and Gleam projects.

item.title: Docker Hub
item.description: Container image library for discovering and publishing containerised applications.

item.title: Flathub
item.description: Cross-distribution application store for Linux, distributing software as Flatpak packages.

item.title: Snap Store
item.description: Application store for Linux operated by Canonical, distributing software packaged as snaps.

item.title: F-Droid
item.description: Android application catalogue restricted to free and open-source software.

item.title: Visual Studio Marketplace
item.description: Microsoft marketplace distributing extensions for the Visual Studio family of products.

item.title: JetBrains Marketplace
item.description: Plugin marketplace for JetBrains integrated development environments.

item.title: Atlassian Marketplace
item.description: Marketplace of applications extending Atlassian products, with user ratings on each listing.

item.title: WooCommerce extensions
item.description: Marketplace of extensions, themes and services for the WooCommerce ecommerce platform, operated by Automattic.

item.title: Drupal Modules
item.description: Directory of contributed modules extending Drupal, governed by the non-profit Drupal Association.

item.title: Joomla! Extensions Directory
item.description: Official catalogue of Joomla extensions, organised by category with user ratings and reviews.

item.title: GetApp
item.description: Business software comparison directory with verified user reviews, operated by Nubera eBusiness.

item.title: PeerSpot
item.description: Enterprise technology review platform that verifies every reviewer as a recent user of the product.

item.title: Slashdot Software Directory
item.description: Business software comparison directory organised by category, with user ratings on each product.

item.title: SourceForge
item.description: Open-source project host and business software comparison platform with user reviews.

item.title: SaaSHub
item.description: Independent software marketplace for discovering and comparing alternatives, with community-run expert assessments.

item.title: LibHunt
item.description: Catalogue of open-source projects ranked by mentions across developer communities.

item.title: Foursquare Places
item.description: Point-of-interest dataset covering business locations across more than 200 countries, with an open-source tier.

item.title: Hugging Face
item.description: Collaboration platform hosting machine-learning models, datasets and demo applications.

item.title: Kaggle Datasets
item.description: Catalogue of open datasets for artificial-intelligence and research use, operated by Kaggle under Google.

item.title: Ollama Library
item.description: Public catalogue of large language models packaged for local execution through Ollama.

item.title: Open Collective
item.description: Transparent fund-management platform where collectives and organisations publish their finances publicly.

item.title: The Legal 500
item.description: Legal market guide ranking law firms and practitioners by practice area, published by Legalease since 1987.

item.title: Chambers and Partners
item.description: Legal research publisher ranking firms and lawyers across regional and specialist guides, based on interviews and firm submissions.

item.title: PR Newswire
item.description: Press release distribution service owned by Cision, delivering company announcements to media outlets and newsrooms.

item.title: npm
item.description: Public registry of JavaScript packages and their metadata, installed through the npm command-line client; publishing a public package costs nothing and requires an npm account.

item.title: Google Business Profile
item.description: Google’s free tool for managing how a business appears in Google Search and Maps, covering opening hours, contact details, location, photos and customer reviews once the profile has been verified.

item.title: Swift Package Index
item.description: Open-source index of Swift packages that support Swift Package Manager, where a package enters the index by being submitted to the project’s public package-list repository and meeting a published set of technical requirements.

item.title: G2
item.description: Software review and product-profile platform run by G2.com, Inc., where a vendor submits a product for a research-team eligibility check and then claims the resulting profile, and each review is moderated by a person before it is published.

item.title: Better Business Bureau
item.description: North American non-profit network publishing business profiles, consumer complaints and a paid accreditation programme.

item.title: USPTO Trademark Search
item.description: Federal trademark database of United States registrations and applications, searchable free of charge.

item.title: EDGAR
item.description: Public filing system operated by the US Securities and Exchange Commission, holding registration statements, prospectuses and the periodic reports filed by companies that carry a federal disclosure obligation.

item.title: BrokerCheck
item.description: Free FINRA tool for researching the registration history, qualifications and disclosure events of US brokerage firms, investment adviser firms and the individuals registered with them.

item.title: USAspending.gov
item.description: Federal award transparency database operated by the Treasury Bureau of the Fiscal Service, publishing transaction-level contracts, grants, loans and direct payments reported by agencies under the DATA Act, with recipient profiles keyed by UEI.

item.title: SAM.gov Entity Information
item.description: Federal award registration record operated by GSA, holding the registrations organisations must complete to bid for federal contracts or receive federal assistance, including the Unique Entity ID and the Responsibility/Qualification records formerly published as FAPIIS.

item.title: FDIC BankFind Suite
item.description: Authoritative record of every FDIC-insured depository institution, keyed by FDIC certificate number, covering insurance status, branch offices, structure changes and filed financial reports.

item.title: OCC Financial Institution Search
item.description: Search over the national banks and federal savings associations chartered by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, covering the charter roster, Community Reinvestment Act evaluations, enforcement actions and corporate applications.

item.title: Investment Adviser Public Disclosure
item.description: SEC disclosure system for investment advisers, publishing Form ADV filings by SEC- and state-registered adviser firms, their representatives, and Exempt Reporting Advisers including private fund managers.

item.title: FinCEN MSB Registrant Search
item.description: List of businesses that have filed a Registration of Money Services Business with FinCEN under the Bank Secrecy Act, covering money transmitters, cheque cashers, currency dealers and comparable providers.

item.title: NFA BASIC
item.description: Background Affiliation Status Information Center published by the National Futures Association, showing CFTC registration status, NFA membership and regulatory actions for derivatives firms, commodity pool operators, trading advisers and associated individuals.

item.title: NPPES NPI Registry
item.description: Public enumeration of every assigned National Provider Identifier, covering individual practitioners and organisational healthcare providers, with taxonomy codes and practice addresses as supplied by the provider.

item.title: FDA Establishment Registration and Device Listing
item.description: Registry of medical device establishments registered with the FDA Center for Devices and Radiological Health, together with the devices each has listed, searchable by establishment, owner or operator, product code or proprietary name.

item.title: Tax Exempt Organization Search
item.description: IRS search over five tax-exemption datasets, covering organisations eligible to receive deductible contributions, automatic revocations, filed Form 990 series returns, Form 990-N filings and determination letters.

item.title: Patent Public Search
item.description: USPTO search over granted US patents and published applications, providing full document text and images for the public patent record.

item.title: DMCA Designated Agent Directory
item.description: Copyright Office directory of agents designated by online service providers to receive copyright infringement notifications, resolving a platform to a legal entity name and a service-of-process address.

item.title: TTB List of Permittees
item.description: Published lists of holders of federal alcohol basic permits, released by the Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau as frequently requested FOIA records covering producers, wholesalers and importers.

item.title: Permitted Customs Brokers Listing
item.description: Customs and Border Protection list of customs brokers holding a federal permit to transact customs business, published by port with company contact details.

item.title: Federal Maritime Commission Ocean Transportation Intermediary List
item.description: Federal Maritime Commission lists of licensed ocean freight forwarders and non-vessel-operating common carriers that have met the Commission’s licensing, financial responsibility and tariff requirements.

item.title: FCC Universal Licensing System
item.description: Federal Communications Commission register of wireless radio licences and the applications behind them, keyed by call sign and FCC Registration Number, covering licensee name, radio service, status and expiry.

item.title: FCC Form 499 Filer Database
item.description: Registration records for providers required to file the Telecommunications Reporting Worksheet, giving the 499 Filer ID, the carrier’s legal name, its holding company and its designated agent for service of process.

item.title: FAA Aircraft Registry
item.description: The US civil aircraft register, published by the FAA Civil Aviation Registry, giving registration status, registered owner, manufacturer, model and airworthiness classification for each N-numbered aircraft.

item.title: MSHA Mine Data Retrieval System
item.description: Mine Safety and Health Administration register of every coal and metal or non-metal mine under its jurisdiction since 1970, keyed by Mine ID and linking each mine to its operator and controlling entity alongside inspection and enforcement records.

item.title: FSIS Meat, Poultry and Egg Product Inspection Directory
item.description: Directory of establishments holding a USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service grant of inspection, listing establishment number, activities carried out and the establishment’s commercial identifier.

item.title: SAM.gov Exclusions
item.description: Governmentwide record of parties excluded from federal contracts, subcontracts and federal assistance, listing firms and individuals debarred, suspended, proposed for debarment, declared ineligible or voluntarily excluded by any federal agency.

item.title: HHS OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities
item.description: List of individuals and organisations currently excluded from Medicare, Medicaid and all other federally funded health care programmes, maintained by the HHS Office of Inspector General under the Social Security Act.

item.title: CFTC Sanctions in Effect
item.description: Commodity Futures Trading Commission registers of registration and trading sanctions currently in force against named derivatives-market respondents, together with unpaid reparations awards, searchable by respondent name, alternative name and docket.

item.title: Drug Establishments Current Registration Site
item.description: Publication of currently registered human drug establishments maintained by the FDA Center for Drug Evaluation and Research, giving one row per registered site with its FDA Establishment Identifier, DUNS number and registered business operations.

item.title: CorpOnline
item.description: CorpOnline is the district business-entity register operated by the Government of the District of Columbia, Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection (DLCP), Corporations Division. Search by business name (Starts With / Contains, with an optional sounds-like/soundex method) or entity number, plus an advanced search including principal name and date range. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Registro Electrónico de Corporaciones y Entidades
item.description: Registro Electrónico de Corporaciones y Entidades is the territorial business-entity register operated by the Departamento de Estado de Puerto Rico, Registro de Corporaciones. It covers domestic and foreign corporations, limited liability companies, non-profit corporations and cooperative societies under Ley 164-2009. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Catalyst
item.description: Catalyst is the territorial business-entity register operated by the Government of the United States Virgin Islands, Office of the Lieutenant Governor, Division of Corporations and Trademarks. Search by item name or number with a Starts With / Contains operator, an Advanced mode, and a register selector ("-- Any register --", "Business Names", "Business Entities"). Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Business Records Search
item.description: Business Records Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Office of the Secretary of the State (Connecticut). Coverage: "This search covers all domestic (formed in Connecticut) and foreign (formed outside of Connecticut) entities on record." Trade names (DBAs), trade/service marks and UCC liens are searched through separate tools on the same portal, not through Business Records Search. Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: Corporate Name Search (ICRS)
item.description: Corporate Name Search (ICRS) is the state business-entity register operated by the Maine Department of the Secretary of State — Division of Corporations, UCC & Commissions. Search fields: Two input fields only: "Keyword from name to be searched" and "Charter number", plus the entity-category dropdown above. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Search for a Business Entity
item.description: Search for a Business Entity is the state business-entity register operated by the Secretary of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts — Corporations Division. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Records Service
item.description: Business Records Service is the state business-entity register operated by the New Jersey Department of the Treasury — Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services (DORES). Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Corporation and Business Entity Database
item.description: Corporation and Business Entity Database is the state business-entity register operated by the New York State Department of State — Division of Corporations. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Search for an entity within the RI Business Portal (CIMS)
item.description: Search for an entity within the RI Business Portal (CIMS) is the state business-entity register operated by the Rhode Island Department of State — Business Services Division. Coverage: The entity-name search is scoped on-page as "(Corp., LP, LLP, LLC, Non-resident Landlord)". Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Search for a Business Entity
item.description: Search for a Business Entity is the state business-entity register operated by the Delaware Department of State, Division of Corporations. Search fields: Two search fields only: Entity Name and File Number. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Sunbiz
item.description: Sunbiz is the state business-entity register operated by the Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations. It covers corporations (profit and non-profit), Limited Liability Companies, Limited Partnerships, foreign/out-of-state qualifications, and — unusually — Trademarks, all searchable in the same system. A live detail record returned the entity type label "Florida Profit Corporation". Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: Business Entity Search
item.description: Business Entity Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation (SDAT). Search fields: Three search modes, verified on the live page: Business Name, Department ID, and Employer Identification Number (EIN). Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Registration search
item.description: Business Registration search is the state business-entity register operated by the North Carolina Department of the Secretary of State, Business Registration Division. Search fields: Four search targets: "Company By Name"; "Company by Secretary of State Identification Number (SOSID)"; "Company Officials"; "Registered Agents". Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Organization Search
item.description: Business Organization Search is the state business-entity register operated by the West Virginia Secretary of State. Wildcard matching is officially documented. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Database Search
item.description: Business Database Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Colorado Secretary of State — Business Division. It covers domestic and foreign corporations, LLCs, LPs, LLPs and nonprofit corporations, PLUS trade names and trademarks, all in one combined index. Quick search accepts 'business name, trademark, trade name, ID or document number'. Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: SOSBiz
item.description: SOSBiz is the state business-entity register operated by the Idaho Secretary of State. It covers business entities plus trademarks and notaries, exposed as three distinct search screens on one platform: 'Business Search', 'Trademark Search' and 'Find A Notary'. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Filing Portal
item.description: Business Filing Portal is the state business-entity register operated by the Montana Secretary of State — Business Services Division. Search fields: 'Search by Name or Commission Number' and 'Search available business names'. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Search
item.description: Business Search is the state business-entity register operated by the California Secretary of State — Business Programs Division. It covers corporations, LLCs and limited partnerships, domestic and foreign-qualified. Search fields: Entity name and entity number, with filters for filing type, status and a filing-date range, plus a distinct officer/owner name search field. Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: Hawaii Business Entity Search
item.description: Hawaii Business Entity Search is the state business-entity register operated by the State of Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs — Business Registration Division (BREG). Named public services on the new portal: 'Business Name Search', 'Search and Buy', 'Entity List Builder', 'Manage' (for filing annual reports) and 'Request a Copy or Certified Copy'. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Business Name Search
item.description: Business Name Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Oregon Secretary of State — Corporation Division. It covers business entities registered with the Corporation Division, searchable together with registered agent information. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Corporations and Charities Filing System (CCFS)
item.description: Corporations and Charities Filing System (CCFS) is the state business-entity register operated by the Washington Secretary of State — Corporations and Charities Division. Search fields: Business entity and charity records via a Corporation Search / Business Search screen. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Corporate Registration Information System (CRIS)
item.description: Corporate Registration Information System (CRIS) is the state business-entity register operated by the Wisconsin Department of Financial Institutions — Division of Corporate & Consumer Services, Corporation Bureau. Search fields: Entity name search for name availability and record lookup. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Business Entities Search
item.description: Business Entities Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Office of the Iowa Secretary of State — Business Services. Search fields: Two search types only — Search by Business Name (first few letters or words) or Search by Business Number (complete number, digits only). Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Search
item.description: Business Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Kansas Secretary of State — Business Services Division. Search by business name or by business ID number (both are named in the official purchasing instructions). Every filed document for a business is retrievable through the same search, file-stamped with the date it was filed. Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: Search Business Filings
item.description: Search Business Filings is the state business-entity register operated by the Office of the Minnesota Secretary of State. Search by Business Name or File Number, with three refinements exposed directly on the search form: Search Scope (Begins With / Contains), Filing Status (Active / Inactive) and Include Prior Names (Exclude / Include). Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Corporate & Business Search
item.description: Corporate & Business Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Nebraska Secretary of State. Coverage: The office states searches "are provided to obtain information on the status of all entities, trade names, trademarks, and service marks registered in the State of Nebraska" — so trade names and marks share the register with legal entities rather than sitting in separate systems. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: FirstStop
item.description: FirstStop is the state business-entity register operated by the North Dakota Office of the Secretary of State. Registered businesses and (within the same search) nonprofits. Separate FirstStop searches cover charitable organisations, contractors, lobbyists and notaries, and a browsable list of commercial registered agents is published. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Information Search
item.description: Business Information Search is the state business-entity register operated by the South Dakota Secretary of State — Business Services. It covers business Corporations, Limited Liability Companies, Series LLCs, Nonprofit Corporations, Limited Liability Partnerships, Limited Partnerships, Cooperatives, Business Trusts and DBAs, plus Commercial Registered Agents. Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: Business Entity Search
item.description: Business Entity Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Office of the Kentucky Secretary of State. Coverage: Kentucky and foreign corporations, LLCs, non-profits and other filing entities, with assumed names carried as their own searchable records. Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: Business Entity Search
item.description: Business Entity Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Tennessee Department of State — Office of the Secretary of State, Division of Business Services. Search fields: A single search box with an "Active Entities Only" toggle, Search and Clear controls, and a "How to use this search" helper. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Entity Search
item.description: Business Entity Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Arkansas Secretary of State, Business & Commercial Services (BCS) Division. Search fields: Corporation Type; Name; Fictitious Name; Registered Agent (RA); RA City; RA State; Filing #. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Search for Louisiana Business Filings
item.description: Search for Louisiana Business Filings is the state business-entity register operated by the Louisiana Department of State — Office of the Secretary of State, Commercial Division. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: SOSDirect
item.description: SOSDirect is the state business-entity register operated by the Office of the Texas Secretary of State. It covers business entities formed or registered under the Texas Business Organizations Code and filed with the Secretary of State (corporations, LLCs, LPs, LLPs, nonprofits, foreign registrations), together with assumed names, trademarks and UCC filings inside the same application. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Business Entity Search
item.description: Business Entity Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Nevada Secretary of State. Search fields: Entity, trademark, trade name, service mark, reserved name and business licence records. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Gemeinsames Registerportal der Länder
item.description: Joint German register portal aggregating the commercial, cooperative, partnership and association registers of all federal states.

item.title: Bundesanzeiger
item.description: German federal gazette publishing statutory corporate announcements and filed annual financial statements.

item.title: Companies House Register
item.description: Statutory register of UK companies operated by Companies House, holding filed accounts, officers and registered office data.

item.title: Care Quality Commission
item.description: Statutory regulator of health and social care in England, publishing a searchable directory of registered providers with inspection ratings.

item.title: Financial Services Register
item.description: Public record of the firms and individuals authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority or the Prudential Regulation Authority, which also carries warnings about unauthorised firms and clone-firm impersonations.

item.title: L'Annuaire des Entreprises
item.description: French government directory publishing official legal information on companies, associations and public administrations.

item.title: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle
item.description: French state institute maintaining the national business register alongside trademark, patent and design registers.

item.title: Colegio de Registradores de España
item.description: Spanish association of registrars operating the commercial, property, movable-property and insolvency registries.

item.title: Registro Imprese
item.description: Italian Business Register run by InfoCamere with the Chambers of Commerce, holding company data, officers, shareholdings and filed financial statements.

item.title: Search for a Federal Corporation
item.description: Federal corporation search operated by Corporations Canada, confirming the existence of federally incorporated bodies.

item.title: ABN Lookup
item.description: Australian Government service exposing public Australian Business Number records, including entity status, type and GST registration.

item.title: Search ASIC registers
item.description: Australian regulator search covering company, business name, financial adviser and banned-person registers.

item.title: Veřejný rejstřík a Sbírka listin
item.description: Czech public register operated by the Ministry of Justice, covering the commercial register, insolvency register and beneficial-owner records.

item.title: Baza Internetowa REGON
item.description: Polish national business entity register operated by the Central Statistical Office, holding REGON, NIP and KRS identifiers.

item.title: Central Registration and Information on Economic Activity
item.description: Polish register of sole traders and the self-employed, supervised by the Ministry of Development and Technology, offering a free public search that returns entrepreneur records and downloadable certificates.
